title: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk as

translated_title: 离线让在线更好：面向视频生成的校准缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 标记合并（Token merging）是一种有效降低自回归视频生成中KV缓存内存消耗的方法，其通过聚类时间上冗余的标记并仅保留一小组代表性标记来实现。然而，现有方法通常在所有注意力层和头上应用统一的合并比例。我们观察到，不同的层和头对标记合并表现出显著不同却相互关联的敏感性，并且这些敏感性模式在不同提示词之间保持一致。基于这一观察，我们提出了CALM（Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging，层-头合并的校准分配），利用离线校准来改进在线缓存压缩。由于穷举评估所有可能的层-头分配方案的代价过于高昂，为实现高效校准，我们证明注意力输出误差与端到端视频质量强相关，因此可以作为分配风险的轻量级代理指标……
tldr: 该论文提出CALM方法，利用离线校准捕捉不同注意力层和头对标记合并的敏感性差异，以注意力输出误差作为轻量级代理指标，为在线视频生成的KV缓存压缩实现自适应的层-头合并分配，从而以更低开销获得更高质量的视频。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CALM, which uses offline calibration to capture the varying sensitivities of attention layers and heads to token merging, employing attention-output error as a lightweight proxy to achieve adaptive layer-head allocation for online KV-cache compression in video generation, yielding better video quality at lower cost.
